Synopsis:

A sequel to Share One's Lot with Another, set in an alternate universe where Gojo and Geto have become notorious curse users after escaping Geto's secret execution.

Now operating from a secluded mountain temple, Gojo takes on assassination contracts while Geto poses as a religious leader, collecting money and curses from his followers. Together, they plot to eliminate the higher-ups and reshape the jujutsu world.

One day, while Gojo is away, a group of curse users arrives under the guise of visitors. Their true objective? To ambush Geto and force him into starring in an adult film. With Gojo nowhere in sight, can Geto protect himself?

A dark comedy featuring an established Gojo × Geto relationship and a surprisingly happy married-couple dynamic.

Content Notes: Blood and violence, attempted sexual assault, and adult themes.

This sequel can be read as a standalone story.
n: [Doujinshi] [Gekikara Ryouri (Ohiya)] Share One's Lot with Another 2 (Jujutsu Kaisen)
